sermon.title: Friends - August 20, 2023
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Continuing the Job series, the message looks at Job’s friends, who accused him and his children of sin. Bad things happen to good and innocent people, tribulation produces perseverance, and God calls us to grow to maturity; Jesus laid down His life and calls us friends if we do what He commands. The service closes with an altar call and prayer for Paul before baptism.

He cites “John 16:33,” “Job 6:14,” and “Revelations 20” (Revelation 20:12–15). “1 John 1 19” in the captions is 1 John 1:9.

faqs.question: What did Job’s wife tell him?
faqs.answer: To die; but he wasn’t afraid of his wife.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still hold fast to your integrity? Curse God and die!”

faqs.question: How long is the book of Job?
faqs.answer: Thirty-plus chapters, he says, so he pulls out a few things.

faqs.question: Is there another way to get perseverance?
faqs.answer: He jokes about asking God for perseverance without going through problems.

faqs.question: Did God leave Job?
faqs.answer: No; He just backed off a little; He will never leave us nor forsake us.

faqs.question: How do fools react to instruction?
faqs.answer: They cringe and say stop telling me what to do.

faqs.question: What did he see in New York?
faqs.answer: Ground Zero with the Twin Towers memorial, close to the new Freedom Tower.

faqs.question: Is he patient?
faqs.answer: He jokes he can’t handle traffic anymore, and says we’re not patient with God either.

faqs.question: Do doctors know everything?
faqs.answer: No; his doctor had to figure out it was poison oak; but they practice.

faqs.question: Why was the ark of the covenant gold?
faqs.answer: For a reason: God sees us as precious.

faqs.question: Do I understand all Scripture?
faqs.answer: He says he doesn’t understand it all the time; even with a hurricane coming you can find the word.
